# Build report: latent (partial)

Latent Image (/games/latent/) is built and playable end to end in games/latent/** (about 5,200 lines of TypeScript, strict and type-clean). The darkroom opens on a black screen with PULL and a bead chain. Pulling it turns on the red 1-bit safelight room, where the tutorial slate is already exposed in the easel. From there the player develops it in a rockable shallow-water tray (@shared/fluid), stops, fixes and hangs it, then searches all 43 verbatim documents at the amber terminal (5-result cap, oldest first, receipt tape). They load and develop rolls blind in the changing bag and tank (rhythm, kinks, dial, invert, rap, push), check strips under a loupe at the light table, and print any frame. The enlarger has magnification, crop, focus, a grain focuser, flip, grades 0–5, a timer, test strips, and a dodge wand and burn card with physical penumbra. A measured LEGIBLE stamp marks prints that resolve their detail. Prints go on the drying line and into the envelope, and CLOSE 03-0417 leads to FILE or PURGE, with clippings, fax and last lines chosen by the envelope's facts.

Every page is one Canvas 2D luminance layer passed through a Bayer+IGN dither (@shared/dither threshold map) into each station's two-tone palette. Crisp text and the player's red are drawn on top. All 156 frames are painted procedurally in Canvas 2D (log-encoded HDR luminance, two encoding passes merged), not as three.js dioramas. __game.solve() returns 43/43 detail rows passing: each solution recipe passes, and the naive print fails wherever the GDD requires it to. __game.lint() returns []. Smoke steps pass on desktop and on --mobile (390 px, no horizontal overflow). A real-input walk worked: chain pull, into DEV, rocking, stop, fix, hang, typing a search, and a full roll developed by keyboard in the bag and tank. No console errors. Status is partial because several SHOULD items, some layout polish, and per-agent handoff notes are not done.

## Works

- Page template per §3.4 (games/latent/index.html): en-CA, data-game=latent, scheme lock dark, grain off, inline theme boot script, #stage, main.ts. Shell header with Help (control table and tips), Settings (steady hands, lights in the bag, reduced motion, high contrast, terminal text size ×1/×1.5/×2) and New night.
- Opening: black screen with PULL and a 12-bead Verlet chain. Pulling it turns on the red safelight (swinging pendulum light); later pulls toggle white light (400 ms blowout), which fogs unfixed paper. L key does the same.
- Tutorial: Roll 7 F1 (slate R.K. / 16.2.79 / ODGERS NEGS) is pre-exposed in the easel under the cursive 'Start here' card. It develops visibly in the DEV tray, then stop, fix, hang. Hanging it sets stage A and blinks the terminal on the rail.
- Terminal: boot sequence, HOLD pre-typed and selected, full-text index (tokeniser and stopwords per GDD §5.9), 1–2 word AND queries, 5-result cap with total count, all §7.2 responses, unread markers, document view with Dot's margins in cursive, wheel/drag/keyboard scrolling, double-click or long-press a word to add it to the query, receipt tape with re-run on click, RUTH/MINA printed lower-case on the tape, CLOSE 03-0417 → FILE/PURGE → YES/NO. Hidden <input> for the phone keyboard; aria-live mirror of results and documents.
- Search counts match the story bible's vocabulary map: HOLD 6, KESSANE 9, HALE 12, KESSANE CONTRACT 2, PORT AVEL 3, BOOT 1, LANTERN 0, STAIRWELL 0 and others, all checked by __game.lint().
- Frames: all 11 rolls, 156 recipes, 22 procedural templates (slate, shopfront, interior, closeup, shadow, yard, step, alley in true one-point perspective with 75 mm courses and the 1.52 m flood line at camera heights 1.66 m and 1.46 m, van, party, plant, diner with mirrored text, bus, flat, dock, street, copystand with prints inside prints and a negative strip, handover, window ×36 with seasons and jar contents, F36 reflection, fogged, unexposed). Lens vignette, halation, motion blur, camera shake and roll; insets for the hardest small details; Δ ground-truth maps per detail.
- Film model per GDD §5.3: development factor, curve with toe and shoulder, fog, push, film-space grain, kink crescents, bubbles, bromide streaks. Roll 7 is pre-developed with its 14 crescents.
- Changing bag: total black except the reel's luminous dot; pop the cap, pull the leader ×3, alternate ←/→ (or taps on the left and right halves of the screen) with clean, risky and slow strokes; kinks are placed on kink-safe positions, with haptics. Tank: dial (15 s detents, 4:00–16:00), pour, invert, rap, development compressed 10×, timer bell, pour out → DevResult. Tape line ROLL n DEV m:ss .... OK/+1/+2; clock +20 min.
- Light table: carton of 11 cassettes with block-capital, cursive or DX-checkerboard labels and a turn-over property sticker; send a cassette to the tank; developed rolls as strips of 6 negatives (computed from the real negative density, gate tooth, edge numbers); 4×/8× loupe offset 72 px above a finger on touch; ←/→ to step frames; send a frame to the carrier (chip, E, or double-click).
- Enlarger and easel: magnification 2–16 by dragging the head, the wheel or +/−; crop by dragging the projection; focus by circular drag on the knob, Shift+wheel or ,/. with a tick at sharp focus; 8× grain focuser; flip; grades 0–5; timer 1–60 s; timed exposure, test strip (5T…1T bands); dodge wand and burn card whose shadows have physical penumbra, height on the wheel; inverse-square light falloff with height; carrier mask and gate tooth printed at low magnification.
- Trays: three 32×24 shallow-water trays (@shared/fluid TrayFluid) on a spring tilt from dragging or W/S/Q/E, with liquid shading and refraction over the print. Per-cell wetness and agitation drive development with induction time; stop (τ 0.4 s), fix (8 s), white-light fog. Rising sine-cluster hint while developing; LEGIBLE stamp evaluated when fixing completes, stamp sound, tape line '* LEGIBLE Rn/Fn'.
- Legibility: GDD §5.8 pipeline with ρ computed as a partial correlation against the detail-off scene, plus a minimum display-contrast gate (see deviations). Pass also requires coverage ≥ 0.9, M ≥ mMin, the flip when MIRRORED, and no fog.
- Drying line: prints pegged in order with gentle sway; drag to reorder; drag onto the envelope (6 red slots) or use the chip; T, right-click or long-press turns a print over to show its recipe and the red LEGIBLE stamp with frame and time; double-click opens a full-screen view.
- Endings: FILE (Atwell's line, clippings by fact groups per GDD §5.10, fax, headstone line, last line) and PURGE (one print kept, medal clipping), in a halftone clipping palette. Desk phone with three-tier hints per stage (A–K) from the rail button, the terminal phone or P; unprompted calls at 2:30 with no search, after a legible Roll 7 F9/F10 print, and at 05:59.
- Saves: local('latent') key slot0 (SaveV1 JSON, debounced 2 s, flushed on hidden and pagehide); idb('latent') keys print:<id> (density grid quantised to Uint8, 80 KB). ?reset=1 and ?fresh=1 honoured; NOT SAVING note on the rail when storage is memory-only; hub note written. Clock 21:00–05:59 advances by action and by idle minutes.
- Audio: registerSounds() from games/latent/sounds.ts; Audio.play/loop for key, seek, tape, clunk, relay, enlarger hum, bag zip/tick/kink, glug, rap, lid, timer tick/bell, slosh (energy), lap, tok, drip, stamp, cluster, room (rain), squelch and fax. Silent under ?test=1.
- Records-only fallback (?records=1, or no 2D canvas): DOM amber terminal with the same search and documents.
- window.__game (installGameApi, slug 'latent', version 'latent@1'): state, layout, goto, lights, white, search, openDoc, developRoll, frameReady, load, setEnlarger, expose, develop, stop, fix, hang, print(roll, frame, ops|'solution'|'naive'), envelope, close, solve, lint, seed, skipTo, setSetting, twoColourCheck, advance, plus errors and whenReady from the base contract.
- Verified: desktop smoke (count 6; print(6,6,'solution') legible [KDL_TANNERY]; naive []; lint []; 3 prints; 60 fps in SwiftShader); mobile smoke (scrollWidth ≤ innerWidth, terminal text 14 px); solve() 43/43 rows pass; ending with KDL_PLANT + HEIGHT_MARKS gives the arrest and identity clippings and the R.K. fax; real-input walks of the tutorial print and of developing roll 1; __game.errors() empty throughout; npx tsc clean for games/latent/**.
- Dev harness /games/latent/dev/frames.html (?roll=N): contact sheet of every frame with detail boxes, plus __game.solve() with solution vs naive diagnostics.

## Missing

- SHOULD items not done: grease pencil, hand dodge tool, contact sheets, CRT barrel and phosphor persistence, wet-sheet sag and drips, permanent spill decals, manual save slots 1–3 as cassette stickers, phone tilt for the trays, share-card PNG, Open Lab PNG import, developer exhaustion. Reduced motion, high contrast and steady hands do exist as settings.
- Clipping text is DOM type over a halftone dot background, not a 45° halftone render of the text.
- Holding Space or the Expose chip > 300 ms starts a manual exposure on the chip only; the Space key always runs the timer.
- Tray rocking only tilts the tray that holds the sheet. There is no tongs drag between trays: moves use the small tray targets, chips, or D/H keys. Wall cards: only 'Start here' and 'wait for it' are drawn; the other five technique cards are missing.
- Drag-and-drop gestures are partial: cassette to the tank glyph and frame to the enlarger glyph go through chips or double-click. Two-finger swipe and pinch are not wired; on phones the panes switch with a one-finger swipe or tabs, and enlargement uses the head drag.
- No low-power auto mode and no quality tiers: the Canvas 2D pipeline ran at 40–60 fps under SwiftShader, so none was needed so far.
- Roll 11 scrubbing is via ←/→ and the loupe on 6 strips of 6, not a flip-book animation.
- The enlarger and sheet state (settings, a half-made print) is not saved; reloading mid-print loses that sheet. Developed rolls, prints, tape, documents read and the envelope are all saved.
- No docs/build handoff note: the brief named no notes file and docs/ is off-limits.

## Known bugs

- The 1-bit dither makes some mid-grey areas (darkroom walls, film base on the light table, the envelope) read as busy speckle; flat backgrounds were pushed to pure 0 or 1, but more art tuning would help.
- On phone portrait the enlarger chips cover the 'EXPOSED n s' label under the easel, and the darkroom panes are fairly dense.
- The terminal row hover is click-to-select then click-to-open on desktop (tap opens directly on touch), so there is no mouse-hover highlight.
- Darkroom panes are laid out once per resize; on very short desktop heights (< 600 px) the easel and trays get small.
- While the dev server runs, other agents' edits to src/shared trigger full page reloads that kill long headless evals (solve takes about 60 s). The shoot runs here were retried until clean; this is environmental, not a game bug.

## API deviations

- Rendering: stations and frames use Canvas 2D, not three.js. Stations draw a luminance layer at viewport/cell (cell = clamp(round(min(vw,vh)/360), 2, 4)), dithered on the CPU with @shared/dither getThresholdMap('bayer-ign'). Frames are painted procedurally in Canvas 2D (user space 300×200 = 36×24 mm, log-encoded HDR, two encodings merged), not three.js dioramas. As a result the page needs no WebGL2, so the WebGL2 gate is replaced by a records-only fallback for a missing 2D canvas or ?records=1. The Station interface in core/types.ts is adapted (drawLum/drawCrisp instead of scene/camera).
- FrameImage is 576×384 (GDD 768×512), with 4× or 8× insets only for detail recipes flagged inset (KDL_TANNERY, KDL_NEG, CLAIM_PAID). Δ maps are 160 px wide and also store the detail-off luminance.
- Legibility metric: ρ is the partial correlation of print display luminance with Δ, controlling for log L(detail off) and its square, sampled on a 112-column grid over the bbox. A pass also needs display contrast ≥ 0.08 (the regression slope of print tone per typical detail amplitude). Plain Pearson over the bbox let unrelated structure dominate and passed buried details on naive prints. Naive prints in solve() use normal 8:00 development; solutions use push 12:45 for Rolls 8 and 9.
- 'solution' recipes are produced by a deterministic solver (crop on the bbox, several magnifications, a grade × exposure search with the detail metered to mid-grey), not hand-written per detail. DetailSpec.solution stays optional for overrides.
- Luminance tuning within the story bible's ±20% allowance: KDL_TANNERY glyphs 0.65 on 0.95; CANS_TANNERY figure 0.02 on 0.008; CLAIM_PAID tab drawn on two lines with '— PAID' larger. KDL_PLANT motion blur is 0.6% of frame width instead of 1.2%; at 1.2% no recipe could pass. Party: Hale's leg is dark. The Roll 5 F4 marks were moved onto the jamb to sit inside the bbox.
- __game.ready is the base boolean plus whenReady(), per architecture §3.7. Extra test members: white(on), twoColourCheck(), advance(frames, dt). lights(true) means the safelight.
- Fonts: frames and UI use the installed Fontsource families (Archivo, Caveat, IBM Plex Mono), loaded before painting so frames stay deterministic. The GDD's code-defined termFont, blockFont and strokeFont were not written.
- The station rail, chips, phone card and endings are DOM in the station palette (CSS variables --li-ink/--li-light), not glyphs drawn in the canvas, for touch targets and keyboard reach.
- The paper curve comes from @shared/photochem gradedPaperCurve(grade, 'latent') and paperDensity. Film curve, grain and kinks follow GDD §5.3 directly.

## Requests

- Orchestrator: games/latent/index.html now carries the full page template; src/hub/placeholder.css is no longer referenced by Latent.
- Orchestrator, for later integration or posters: there is no __game.poster() yet. A poster could reuse the tray developing the Roll 7 F1 slate under the safelight.
- shared-audio: everything plays through games/latent/sounds.ts ids. The room loop's rain param and the slosh energy (0..1) are set every frame; please check the loops tolerate frequent setMany calls.
- Environment: other agents' saves to src/shared/** trigger full page reloads on long-running headless pages (for example this game's 60 s solve()). Worth knowing for every integration smoke run.
